hintSalon: Tick the services you want, then tap Pick a time at the bottom.
hintPickTime: Tap a day, then a free time. Then tap Continue at the bottom.
hintBooking: Move or cancel with the buttons further down.
stepServices: Pick a salon and tick services
stepTime: Pick a free time and book
stepCode: At the salon, show your code and pay there
rulesLine: Free to cancel until {hours} hour before the start, and for {minutes} minutes after booking. Missed bookings and late cancels count: {strikes} in {days} days stop online booking for {pause} days.
visitTipTitle: Want a reminder for next time?
visitTipBody: We can message you when it's time for your next visit, and when a salon you've been to has an offer. Switch off what you don't want.
signInForSalon: Sign in to book at the salon you opened. You'll come straight back to it.
saveHomeBody: Save this spot as Home. Then one tap finds salons near home, wherever you are.
